title: chenopodium ambrosioides subsp. chilense
intro: Chenopodium ambrosioides subsp. chilense, commonly known as Chilean wormwood or Mexican tea, is a plant species in the Amaranthaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, which can help soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Chenopodium ambrosioides subsp. chilense include its ability to act as an expectorant, antispasmodic, and carminative, making it effective in treating respiratory issues and reducing flatulence. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
